title: Data structures & commands
summary: Strings, lists, hashes, sets, sorted sets, streams, bitmaps, hyperloglog and geospatial — the command surface and time complexity of each structure.

title: Keys, keyspace & expiry
summary: Key naming and format, generic key commands, active vs lazy expiry, TTL semantics, SCAN vs KEYS, and big-key hazards.

title: Data modeling
summary: Mapping domain entities to Redis structures, one-to-many and many-to-many patterns, aggregation and secondary-index strategies, and choosing between structures.

title: Performance & debugging
summary: The single-threaded event loop, Big-O command selection, O(N) hazards, latency tooling (SLOWLOG, LATENCY, INFO, MONITOR), pipelines, and transactions.

title: Replication, HA & clustering
summary: Replication topologies, Sentinel-managed failover, cluster topology with 16384 hash slots, hash tags, MOVED/ASK redirects, resharding and failover.

title: Persistence & durability
summary: RDB snapshots, AOF with fsync policies, rewrite, hybrid persistence, and what survives a restart under each configuration.

title: Security & configuration
summary: ACL users and permissions, TLS, network exposure (bind, protected-mode), maxmemory and eviction policies, and lazy freeing.

title: Java clients & application patterns
summary: Jedis, Lettuce and Redisson trade-offs, connection pooling, serialization, pipelines and transactions from Java, plus cache-aside, sessions, rate limiting and streams in services.

title: Redis Software install & upgrade
summary: Redis Software (Enterprise) requirements, cluster bootstrap, licenses, certificates, rolling upgrades and software security patches.

title: Cluster & database operations
summary: Cluster lifecycle with the Cluster Manager and rladmin — node add/remove, rack awareness, DMC/proxy, database provisioning and limits, endpoints, backup/restore, and live migration.

title: Monitoring & troubleshooting
summary: Metrics and alerts, logs, the job scheduler, support bundles, and the common failure playbooks an operator runs day to day.

title: Cloud architecture
summary: How Redis Cloud is put together — subscriptions, tiers (Essentials, Essentials with Redis Flex, Pro), regions, availability, and what each capability costs where.

title: Subscription administration
summary: Account and subscription lifecycle — plans and pricing structure, payment, subscription settings, cloud-account/marketplace billing, and administrative access control.

title: Database administration
summary: Creating and managing Redis Cloud databases — capabilities and limits per tier, sizing, modules, versioning/cloning, configuration changes, and deletion/recovery.

title: Security
summary: CIDR allowlists, VPC peering, TLS enforcement, ACLs and role-based access, and the shared-responsibility split owned by the operator.

title: Networking
summary: Private endpoints, VPC peering, Private Service Connect, prefix/DNS handling, and port/protocol realities of client connectivity.

title: Monitoring
summary: Metrics and alerting in Redis Cloud — standard vs advanced monitoring, alert thresholds and delivery, integrations (Prometheus/DataDog/New Relic/CloudWatch), and audit logs.

title: Automation
summary: The Redis Cloud REST API — account/subscription/database endpoints, API keys and account keys, ci/cd-friendly flows, Terraform provider basics.

title: Data access
summary: Connecting clients — endpoints and ports, TLS/SNI, users and ACLs on databases, and the client-side facts (timeouts, cluster-mode/RESP handling) operators must support.
